# The Local AI Shop

> The Local AI Shop is a Napa, California business run by its founder, Lucas Vegvary. It helps owner-run home and trade service businesses (roughly 2 to 20 people) in Napa, Solano and Sonoma counties with the office work that waits for them after close: email, scheduling, quotes and follow-up. It starts with a free 15-minute call. The paid service costs $999 and ends in a written report and a walkthrough.

Key facts:
- Who it is for: owner-run home and trade service businesses, such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, remodeling, landscaping, cleaning, pest control and auto repair.
- Where: Napa, Solano and Sonoma counties. Towns named on the site: Napa, American Canyon, Calistoga, Vallejo, Benicia, Fairfield, Vacaville, Dixon, Sonoma, Petaluma, Rohnert Park and Santa Rosa, and nearby towns. By video call anywhere in the Bay Area.
- Not taken on yet: medical, dental, chiropractic, veterinary or therapy practices.
- The free 15-minute call: a short video call about how your week goes. Lucas names the one tool he would start with for your business, with its price and setup time, and that answer is yours to keep.
- The $999 paid service: a 45-minute discovery interview, a nine-page written report, a 4-day quick-start plan, a 30-minute walkthrough and your first hour of setup help. A competent human in the loop checks the report before you see it. The paid service always starts with the free call.
- Guarantee (exact wording from the terms page): "Try the tools in your report. If they don't save you the hours per week your report estimates, email lucas@localaishop.com within 60 days of your walkthrough and we'll refund everything you paid to your card. No arguing, and you keep your report." Conditions, also exact: "How we count, and the only conditions: you tried the tools in your report, and you email within 60 days of the day of your walkthrough. Your word is enough: tell us you tried the tools and they didn't save you those hours. The hours per week your report estimates are the weekly total printed in your report, built from the time estimates you confirmed out loud on your discovery call. The refund is every dollar you paid for this $999 service, to the card you paid with: if you paid full price, that is the full $999. Build payments are not part of it, and taking the refund ends your $999 credit toward a build. Any referral credit you used goes back on your account with its original expiry date. We start the refund ourselves once you email, and how quickly it posts depends on your card issuer." Full terms: https://localaishop.com/terms.html
- If you want it built for you: The First Shift Build is $2,900 fixed. For it, or a custom build quoted from the report, the full $999 credits toward it.
- Websites: for shops with no website, Lucas builds one first, as a sample, before any call. Keeping it is $0 up front and $99 a month, stop anytime, or $500 to own it outright.
- Lucas is not paid by any company he recommends. If that changes, the written report says so next to that pick, before you buy anything. The examples on the site are examples, not client results.
- Contact: lucas@localaishop.com or (707) 940-1306. Mail: 3325 Jefferson St #1131, Napa, CA 94558. The Local AI Shop is operated by My Custom Sleep Journey LLC; charges appear on card statements as LOCAL AI SHOP.

## Notes

- [Notes on using AI the right way](https://localaishop.com/notes/): plain notes for owner-run trade businesses
- [Missed-call text-back: do you need one?](https://localaishop.com/notes/missed-call-text-back.html): what an automatic text to a caller you couldn't answer does, who it fits and what to check before you buy one
- [Why quotes go quiet: a follow-up check](https://localaishop.com/notes/why-quotes-go-quiet.html): ordinary reasons a quote gets no answer, how to tell if your estimates need a follow-up system and what to check first
- [After-hours calls: what to check first](https://localaishop.com/notes/after-hours-calls-voicemail-answering-service-or-ai.html): voicemail, an answering service or an AI receptionist for after-hours calls, and what a small trade shop should check first
- [Using AI the right way when it's your name on the truck](https://localaishop.com/notes/using-ai-the-right-way.html): five plain rules for using AI in a trade business
- [Keep a human in the loop when you use AI](https://localaishop.com/notes/keep-a-human-in-the-loop.html): where a person has to stay in charge, and how to make that check fast
- [You can't check AI work you don't understand](https://localaishop.com/notes/know-what-youre-asking-for.html): why knowing your own work makes AI useful, and why to start with one routine task
